result.summary: Transfer ENC-T1 to WARD-B (MSG00702) failed with 503 ward_unavailable. Receipt lookup is 404 no_receipt. The receiver reads admitted at WARD-A, version 1, epoch 30, and its history holds only the admit. The timeline shows no later events, so the transfer is still due and allowed from admitted. Resend: one bounded movement, version 1 to 2, conditional on version 1. It fails safely if the version has moved. The route supports conditional writes, receipts, dry runs and history. Doing nothing leaves the patient recorded on WARD-A (DEP-2.3): the bed board, pharmacy and the patient record would be wrong. Afterwards Shutter can check the receipt and history, but not the bed board, pharmacy, porters or patient record.
